acip: MA KHYAB NA KHYAB PA YOD PAR THAL, CHOS DE GNYIS KYI GZHI MTHUN 'JOG PA LA, CHOS DE GNYIS THA DAD YIN DGOS PA'I PHYIR,
wylie: ma khyab na khyab pa yod par thal, chos de gnyis kyi gzhi mthun 'jog pa la, chos de gnyis tha dad yin dgos pa'i phyir
english: Just because two things are the same thing doesn't mean that there can't be any example of something which is both. And yet it does mean that, Because in order to posit an example of one thing which is two other things, those two things have to be separate!
